div.head: II Cn 65
div.ab: Gif hwa burhbote oððe brycgbote oððe fyrdfare forsitte, gebete mid CXX scyll' þam cingce on Engla lage, ⁊ on Dena lage swa hit ær stod; oððe geladige hine: namic man him XIIII, ⁊ begyte XI.

Gif hwa burhbote oððe bricgbote oððe fyrdfare forsitte, gebete mid hundtwel[f]tigum scill' þam cyninge on Engla lage, ⁊ on Dena lage swa hit ær stod; oððe geladige hine: namige him man XIIII, ⁊ begyte XI.

Si quis burhbotam uel brigbotam (id est burgi uel pontis emendationem [refectionem]) uel fyrdfare (id est in exercitum ire) supersederit, emendet hoc erga regem CXX solidis in Anglorum laga, in Denalaga sicut stetit antea; uel ita se adlegiet: nominentur ei XIIII, et adquirat ex eis XI.

Burhbote. Gyf hwa buruhbote oððe brygcebote oððe fyrdfare forsitte, gebete mid hundtwentigum scill' ðam kyncge on Engle lage, ⁊ on Dena lage swa hit ær stod, oððe geladige hine, (⁊) namige man him XIIII ⁊ begyte XI.

The repair of fortifications. If anyone neglects the repair of fortifications or of bridges or military service, he shall pay 120 shillings as compensation to the king in districts under English law, and in the Danelaw the amount fixed by existing regulations; or he shall clear himself—[the court] shall nominate 14 compurgators for him and he shall obtain the support of 11 of them.

(Burgbesserung. B) Wenn einer Burgherstellung oder Brückenherrichtung oder Landwehrfahrt versäumt, büsse er dem König nach Engländer-Recht mit 120 Schill., und im Dänen-Recht wie es bisher galt; oder er schwöre sich rein: [das Gericht] ernenne ihm 14, und er gewinne 11 [davon sich zu Eideshelfern].

(Repair of fortifications. B) If anyone neglects the repair of fortifications or the making-ready of bridges or service in the army, let him atone to the king under English law with 120 shillings, and under Danish law as it has held hitherto; or let him clear himself by oath: let [the court] name 14 for him, and let him win 11 [of them as his oath-helpers].
div.note: Liebermann prints G as ‘namic’ (Ld ‘⁊ namige’). In A, ‘hine’ is written with the abbreviation ·N·.
